goal: Expose additive skipped-directory diagnostics on trace-id budget exhaustion, opt-in directory exclusions, and explicit recur-trace-v1 / filename-token guidance.
invariants: Existing trace-id schemas (recur-trace-id-paths-v1, recur-trace-id-declarations-v1, recur-trace-id-inventory-v1, recur-trace-id-context-v1) and all existing coverage fields (complete, entries, files_read, bytes_read, max_entries, max_bytes, omissions) remain intact in name, type, and semantics.

New starvation metadata on incomplete scans (such as stopped_at and unreached_top_dirs) is strictly additive (present or non-empty only when complete == false) so complete scans keep identical JSON payloads.

Default skipped directory names (target, target2, node_modules, build, dist, and hidden dot-directories) and default byte/entry budgets (DEFAULT_BYTES = 33,554,432 bytes / 32 MiB, DEFAULT_ENTRIES = 50,000 entries in trace_relationships.rs) remain unchanged unless the caller explicitly passes repeatable --exclude-dir <DIR> or --max-bytes / --max-entries.

--declared retains strict opt-in <!-- recur-trace-v1 block parsing and all existing diagnostic codes (invalid_identifier, invalid_artifact, invalid_dependency, unknown_record, unterminated_metadata, duplicate_authority, conflicting_revision) tested in julia-tests/main.improvement.34.trace.test.jl.

--list-ids continues to extract content tokens using the existing identifier grammar without fabricating declarations; documentation and help clarify how multi-hyphenated filenames split tokens and how recur files complements content token inventory.
All trace-id scan modes remain strictly read-only and canonical-root confined.
A failing baseline demonstrates the budget-starvation visibility gap; it does not prove a fix or satisfy final acceptance.

observations: Running recur trace-id 'robo.**' --scope '**' --list-ids -d C:/src/kicad_ra hit the default 1 MiB byte_budget inside alphabetically early exports/ (large SVG/HTML/JSON artifacts) and stopped before ever reaching scripts/, trace/, or warps/, printing only 'byte_budget: stopped after reading 1048576 of 1048576 bytes' without naming which top-level folders were never visited.

Callers could work around large artifact folders only by guessing --max-bytes 10000000 or running separate -d subqueries because no opt-in --exclude-dir <NAME> flag existed for generated export folders.

recur trace-id 'robo.**' --scope '**' --declared -d C:/src/kicad_ra exited 1 with empty declarations even though .warp-map.json and trace/*.json declared 'defines'/'produces'/'consumes', because --help said 'Show explicit structured trace declarations and pins' without mentioning the required <!-- recur-trace-v1 marker block.

--list-ids extracted filename substrings inside prose such as 'robo.prototype.refinement.sol.slice-0' (truncated at the second hyphen of 'slice-0-baseline') without guidance distinguishing content token extraction from recur files '<BASE>.**' path discovery.

final_state.description: When alphabetical traversal exhausts byte or entry budgets, trace-id tells the caller where traversal stopped and which top-level directories were left unvisited, lets callers opt into --exclude-dir <NAME> without inflating memory budgets, and clearly documents <!-- recur-trace-v1 blocks vs content token inventory.
required_observations: When byte_budget or entry_budget stops trace_relationships::scan early, coverage includes additive starvation details (e.g. stopped_at relative path and unreached_top_dirs array of unvisited root directories) and stderr 'Trace-ID discovery incomplete:' names the unreached top-level directories and suggests --max-bytes / --exclude-dir / narrower -d.
Repeatable --exclude-dir <NAME> skips matching directory names across unscoped path search, --declared, --list-ids, --context, and scoped trace-id modes while preserving canonical root safety.

recur trace-id --help and docs/main.command.trace-id.eventness.discovery.report.md explicitly document the <!-- recur-trace-v1 header syntax for --declared and explain how --list-ids single-hyphen token boundaries relate to recur files path queries.
Existing trace_relationships unit tests, julia-tests/main.improvement.34.trace.test.jl, and julia-tests/main.improvement.34.trace-context.test.jl pass without regression.
